case.pattern_description: The pattern involves structuring several online purchases within an hour, each kept just under the $500 authorization threshold. It affects card C04697-K1 under customer C04697 and was discovered via Sentinel sweep near-threshold detection and graph episode modeling.

evidence.claim: Three card transactions from 2016-12-10 20:34:25 to 2016-12-10 20:39:21 constitute a single episode with gaps under 48 hours, totaling $1,499.85.
Three online purchases executed within 5 minutes, priced at $499.97, $499.91, and $499.97, respectively, with amounts kept under an authorization threshold.
The closed-case classifier assigns a score of 0.02 to flagged transaction 3531493, aligning with the card's legitimate history while the bank risk score is 0.04.

The device profile Windows | Windows 10 | chrome 66.0 | 1920x1080 was utilized by 55 other cards in the 30 days prior to the alert, with associated cases including CASE-HHG-007, CASE-HHG-019, CASE-SEN-002, CC-0005, CC-0028, and CC-0033.
Fifty-two cards completed their first purchase in billing region 299.0 during the 7 days prior to the alert, with 9 linked to cases out of 2075 historical cards.
Nearest historical cases retrieved from memory include CASE-SEN-008, CASE-SEN-007, CASE-SEN-002, CASE-SEN-009, CASE-SEN-003, and CASE-SEN-004.
Fraud Policy R1 regarding verification before blocking on a weak signal was evaluated for the BLOCK_CARD basis.
Fraud Policy R3 regarding customer transaction confirmation was retrieved as contextual guidance.
Fraud Policy R5 regarding card testing was retrieved as contextual guidance.
Fraud Policy action definitions were retrieved as contextual guidance.
Typology and regulatory guidance regarding card-not-present fraud, card testing, and account takeover were retrieved as context.

case.summary: Case SEN-014 was opened following a Sentinel near-threshold scan on card C04697-K1 held by customer C04697. Graph analysis confirmed a fraud verdict with a 0.90 probability across an episode of 3 transactions totaling $1,499.85. The activity featured structuring tactics, keeping transaction amounts just under the $500 threshold within 5 minutes on 2016-12-10. Consequently, the final recommended actions are BLOCK_CARD routed to L1, CREATE_CASE routed to auto, and FILE_REPORT routed to L2 per §3a.

sar.narrative: Customer C04697 utilizing card C04697-K1 engaged in suspicious structuring activity on 2016-12-10. A series of 3 online transactions totaling $1,499.85 (including transactions 3531473, 3531477, and 3531493) were executed within 5 minutes. The activity took place online within billing region 299.0 using the device profile Windows | Windows 10 | chrome 66.0 | 1920x1080. This activity is suspicious because the amounts were deliberately kept just under the $500 authorization threshold to evade detection. Connected cards were not identified in this specific sweep, but the device profile has links to other historical cases such as CASE-HHG-007, CASE-HHG-019, and CASE-SEN-002. Recommended actions include blocking card C04697-K1, creating case SEN-014, and filing a regulatory report.
